title: "Are they interdimensional beings?": UFO investigator offers a new theory about a strange creature
excerpt: A UFO investigator reported a new theory about a strange creature in the desert near the US-Mexico border. The creature was called the 'Valley of Juárez Creature.
content:
A UFO investigator reported a new theory about a strange creature in the desert near the US-Mexico border. The creature was called the 'Valley of Juárez Creature.' It was a small humanoid, about two feet tall, with no hair. The New York Post revealed that it had been allegedly attacking and eating chickens in Mexico. However, authorities in El Paso and Juárez said they had received no such reports. Maussan revealed,

"Why did it appear there? It’s a mystery. Are they interdimensional beings? Are they beings who came with other beings? Did they come in ships?"

Veteran Mexican ufologist José Jaime Maussan explained that the creature was a predator and claimed that the frightening creature might be from outer space. As per El Paso Times, the ufologist shared these details with local Mexican media.

The investigation team claimed that they had placed the cameras in the desert and captured the strange creature with a large white animal. The animal appeared to have a long tail and big limbs, and the team believed that these images prove that an unknown being exists.

Continue reading more about the UFO story.

The UFO investigator offered a new theory about a strange creature

Expand Post

UFO expert José Jaime Maussan claimed that he and his teammates had collected images of the strange creature attacking chickens. Maussan described the creature as fast and clever and explained that it walked upright on two legs, looked somewhat human, and measured several feet in length.

Maussan also noted that the animal caught on camera this month might not be an alien from another planet. Instead, he said that it could be a type of intelligence coming from another dimension that exists in the same universe as Earth.

Daily Mail reported that researchers who worked with Maussan stated that the strange creature didn't look like a rodent, rat, raccoon, or any other usual animal found in the border state of Chihuahua, Mexico. They believed that the creature was different from the common wildlife known in that region. Maussan revealed to NetNoticias.Mx,

"It’s a predator. I’m not saying it’s extraterrestrial, but it is something scary."

He added,

"Its intelligence and agility are truly frightening. I don’t believe it attacks people, but it is affecting the interests of those who live in the so-called Juárez Valley."

During a press conference last weekend, four research assistants working with Maussan explained that they estimated the creature's size after they saw it climbing over a large brick wall. By comparing its body to the bricks, they said that the humanoid measured close to six feet in length from head to tail, with its tail itself about three feet long.

Surveillance cameras recorded the creature moving on the ground and climbing the wall, but never captured it walking on two legs, even though Maussan revealed it could do so. Animal specialists were reportedly consulted, and they concluded that the creature was not a typical mammal found on Earth. However, they suggested that it might be some kind of animal that was mutating.
